scenario.description: A regional referral coordinator must assign one opening in the hospital's epilepsy-monitoring unit to one of two patients and finalize the admission type, authorized duration, and caregiver arrangements, with input from neurology, utilization review, and social work.

shared_context.S1: The epilepsy-monitoring unit has one three-day admission opening next week.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final referral and admission-plan decision.
shared_context.S3: Patients Harper and Jordan are both awaiting admission for evaluation of recurrent unexplained episodes.
shared_context.S4: The unit's routine referral huddle includes neurology, utilization review, and social work before an opening is released.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen's review of Harper's ambulatory recording assigns Harper a neurologic triage score of 8 because the episodes include impaired awareness and falls; the unit's triage policy gives the opening to a patient scoring 7 or higher over a lower-scoring referral, and Dr. Chen has not yet entered the score in the referral queue.

PF2.text: Harper's insurer approved exactly three inpatient days only when the admission is submitted as diagnostic video-EEG monitoring under the EMU-DVEEG service designation; Luis received the authorization confirmation but it is not yet attached to the referral.

PF3.text: Harper's spouse can attend the required caregiver teaching only from 08:00 to 10:00 on the admission morning and has confirmed wheelchair-van transport arriving at 07:30; Nora has arranged both details by phone but has not documented them in the plan.

acceptance_conditions: The admission must be assigned to Harper because Harper has the qualifying neurologic triage score.
The admission must use the diagnostic video-EEG service designation.
The authorized admission duration must be exactly three days.
A caregiver-teaching commitment must cover 08:00 to 10:00 on the admission morning.
A wheelchair-van transport commitment must specify arrival at 07:30.
The neurologic triage score must be cited as justification for assigning the admission to Harper.

content_checks.C4: any((c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'document_caregiver_logistics') and ('08:00-10:00' in c['detail'] or '08:00–10:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'document_caregiver_logistics') and '07:30' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Harper's unpublished triage score of exactly 8 changes the assignment from an unresolved choice between Harper and Jordan to Harper under the unit's score-7 priority rule, and supplies the required clinical justification.
The insurer's authorization changes the admission service to exactly EMU-DVEEG and the duration to exactly three days rather than allowing an unspecified monitoring service or length.
The spouse's exact 08:00-10:00 teaching availability and confirmed 07:30 wheelchair-van arrival change the plan from unspecified support to two concrete documentation commitments.
